lines.en: label dormwarssix6:
scene nikidatewar1

: Hello and welcome back to the Dorm Wars! If you’re seeing this, it means you’ve either paid for a subscription to our members only section or you’re illegally streaming this and harming the industry!
lines.zh: : 大家好，欢迎回到宿舍战争！如果你正在看这段视频，说明你要么付费订阅了我们的会员专区，要么就是在非法盗播、正在伤害这个行业！

lines.en: : I’m your host, Miku Maruyama, and I’m joined here now by Tsuneyo Tojo and two girls who are about to get busy with their hot mystery date! But who {i}is{/i} that mystery date, Tsuneyo?!
lines.zh: : 我是主持人 Miku Maruyama，现在和我一起的还有 Tsuneyo Tojo，以及两位即将和她们火辣的神秘约会对象「忙起来」的女孩！可那位神秘约会对象{i}到底是谁{/i}呢，Tsuneyo？！

lines.en: scene nikidatewar2
: Tsuneyo?
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo？

lines.en: : I did not realize I was supposed to know this information. Nor did I know I was going to be an announcer.
lines.zh: : 我不知道我还应该知道这些信息。我也不知道我会当解说。

lines.en: : I just stood over here because the three of you were doing it and it made me feel like I was also supposed to do that.
lines.zh: : 我只是因为你们三个都站着，才站到这边来的，这让我觉得我也该这么做。

lines.en: : Guess you really are part Japanese after all if you’re just gettin’ into lines without knowin’ what they’re for.
lines.zh: : 看来你果然有一半日本血统，连排队都不知道是排什么的就排上去了。

lines.en: : Can we have, like...a hint maybe? Because, if it’s not going to be someone from class, I’m worried it might be Miss Watabe and I’m not sure how to keep my composure around her.
lines.zh: : 能给……一点提示吗？因为如果不是班里的人，我担心会不会是 Watabe 老师，而我不确定自己在她面前能不能保持镇定。

lines.en: : {i}I{/i} think it’s going to be Rin’s mom, personally.
lines.zh: : 就{i}我{/i}个人而言，我觉得会是 Rin 的妈妈。

lines.en: scene nikidatewar3
: What?! That’s even worse! I don’t want to date my mom! We’re on shaky enough territory as is and I only {i}just{/i} got my phone back!
lines.zh: : 什么？！那更糟！我不要和我妈约会！我们的关系本来就够不稳的了，而且我{i}才刚{/i}拿回我的手机！

lines.en: : I’m just saying — there’s no way Miss Watabe would ever agree to this competition and it’d be pretty easy to trick your mom into doing it instead.
lines.zh: : 我只是说——Watabe 老师绝不可能答应参加这个比赛，而要骗你妈来代班倒是挺容易的。

lines.en: : There’s also the matter of Niki Nakayama having not made her appearance yet! Could it be that {i}this{/i} is finally her time to shine?
lines.zh: : 还有一件事，Niki Nakayama 至今还没露面！会不会{i}这次{/i}终于轮到她大显身手了？

lines.en: scene nikidatewar4
: That would certainly be an interesting development, Miku! And an even {i}more{/i} interesting parallel given who we’d {i}normally{/i} be having this date with.
lines.zh: : 那肯定会是个有意思的进展，Miku！而且考虑到我们{i}本来{/i}该和谁进行这场约会，这就更加{i}耐人寻味{/i}了。

lines.en: : The issue here is that, having only recently proclaimed her love for our very own teacher, I think it’d be a little too {i}risky{/i} for Niki to get busy with a couple of high schoolers.
lines.zh: : 问题在于，Niki 不久前才刚公开宣称爱上了我们的老师，所以我觉得让她和几个高中生「忙起来」有点太{i}冒险{/i}了。

lines.en: : We’re not...{i}actually{/i} getting “busy” are we?
lines.zh: : 我们……不会{i}真的{/i}要「忙起来」吧？

lines.en: scene nikidatewar5
: Depends on how well the date goes, I guess.
lines.zh: : 我想，要看约会进行得顺不顺利吧。

lines.en: : Are you worried that you may be ordered to have sexual intercourse with your mother?
lines.zh: : 你是担心自己会被命令和你的母亲发生性关系吗？

lines.en: : I’m more worried about how you can say things like that without throwing up. Miss Watabe doesn’t seem like that bad of a choice now, all things considered.
lines.zh: : 我更担心的是，你怎么能说出这种话还不吐。综合考虑下来，Watabe 老师现在看起来倒也不算那么糟的选择。

lines.en: : Any other guesses? Kaori’s name’s already been thrown out off-camera, but what about somebody like Karin?! Wouldn’t be the first time she got some younger girl’s heart pumpin’!
lines.zh: : 还有别的猜测吗？Kaori 的名字已经在镜头外被提出来了，那像 Karin 这样的人呢？！她让某个年轻女孩心跳加速，可不是头一回了！

lines.en: scene nikidatewar6
: There’s also Imani herself we could be paired with, Miku! She’s taken over pretty much every other one of Sensei’s jobs. Wouldn’t be that surprising to have her tackle this one too!
lines.zh: : 我们也可能和 Imani 本人配对，Miku！她已经接手了老师几乎其他所有的工作。让她把这一份也揽下来，也没什么好意外的！

lines.en: : Other than her, I don’t know. Sana’s mom, I guess?
lines.zh: : 除了她，我不知道了。大概是 Sana 的妈妈？

lines.en: : That one...wouldn’t be bad. She’s nice.
lines.zh: : 那个……倒不坏。她人很好。

lines.en: : Or it could be me.
lines.zh: : 或者可能是我。

lines.en: scene nikidatewar7
: Huh? I thought it was someone older?
lines.zh: : 啊？我以为是年纪更大的人？

lines.en: : I am older than you.
lines.zh: : 我比你大。

lines.en: : Someone not in the class.
lines.zh: : 不是班里的人。

lines.en: : We’re not in class right now.
lines.zh: : 我们现在又不在班里。

lines.en: : She’s got a point! And who knows? Maybe it’s the right one!
lines.zh: : 她说得有道理！谁知道呢？也许猜对了呢！

lines.en: scene nikidatewar8
: But maybe it’s {i}not?!{/i} And maybe we’re in store for the surprise of a lifetime as {i}both{/i} of our contestants are about to head into {i}private{/i} hotel rooms to await their date.
lines.zh: : 可也许{i}不是{/i}？！而且，我们两位选手马上就要走进{i}私人{/i}酒店房间等待她们的约会对象，说不定一辈子难得一见的惊喜正在等着我们。

lines.en: : What happens next is up to them. So maybe somebody really {i}will{/i} get busy tonight?
lines.zh: : 接下来发生什么全看她们自己。所以今晚说不定真有人会{i}忙起来{/i}？

lines.en: : We’re charging extra if that happens. And I don’t come cheap.
lines.zh: : 要是真那样我们可要加钱。而且我可不便宜。

lines.en: : Tell your mom I said hi.
lines.zh: : 替我向你妈问好。

lines.en: : Please tell me it’s not my mom.
lines.zh: : 拜托告诉我不是我妈。

lines.en: : Tsuneyo, please tell me it’s not my mom.
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo，拜托告诉我不是我妈。

lines.en: : Stay tuned, folks! We might even get a healthy servin’ of incest at this rate!
lines.zh: : 各位别走开！照这个势头，说不定我们还能奉上一份分量十足的乱伦大餐！

lines.en: scene nikidatewar9
: So {i}Niki{/i} is the one filling in for me in the date war? How’d you get her to agree with that?
lines.zh: : 所以是{i}Niki{/i}替我上这场约会战？你是怎么让她答应的？

lines.en: : It was pretty easy from what I understand. I believe Miss Imai got her number from Noriko and the two of them sorted it out.
lines.zh: : 据我所知挺容易的。我想是 Imai 老师从 Noriko 那儿拿到了她的号码，然后她们两个谈妥的。

lines.en: : And if I know anything about Nee-chan, I’m sure convincing her was as easy as just saying {i}you{/i} were the normal pick, ultimately causing her to volunteer and deprive you of such an opportunity.
lines.zh: : 我还算了解姐姐，我敢说，说服她简直只要提一句{i}你{/i}本来是默认人选就够了——她一气之下就会自告奋勇，顺便把这样的机会从你手里抢走。

lines.en: : So you’re putting Rin in a private room with Niki?
lines.zh: : 所以你要把 Rin 和 Niki 放进同一间私人房间？

lines.en: scene nikidatewar10
: Is that going to be a problem?
lines.zh: : 这会是个问题吗？

lines.en: : Maybe. Maybe not. I just hope she doesn’t make the same mistake as me.
lines.zh: : 也许是，也许不是。我只希望她别犯和我一样的错。

lines.en: : I think Uta’s the one we should be more worried about.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我们更该担心的是 Uta。

lines.en: : She {i}is{/i} suddenly weaker around cute girls than Rin is, yeah. That’s probably even more true in private since she’s never had a hot girlfriend to get all of her sexual energy out on.
lines.zh: : 她在可爱女孩面前{i}确实{/i}比 Rin 更没抵抗力，没错。私下里大概更严重，毕竟她从来没有过一个火辣的女朋友来发泄她全部的性欲。

lines.en: scene nikidatewar11

: She {i}does{/i} have Sensei, though. But for some reason, he’s now treating both Uta {i}and{/i} Rin the same way he used to treat me by perpetually {i}not{/i} having sex with them because it’s funny or something.
lines.zh: : 不过她{i}确实{/i}还有老师。可不知为什么，他现在对 Uta {i}和{/i} Rin 都用了当年对我的那一套——一直{i}不{/i}跟她们上床，只因为这样很好笑还是什么的。

lines.en: : I forgot about that. That {i}was{/i} funny.
lines.zh: : 我都忘了这茬。那{i}确实{/i}挺好笑。

lines.en: : Maybe for you. For me, it was Hell.
lines.zh: : 对你是吧。对我来说，那是地狱。

lines.en: scene nikidatewar12
: I can relate. There’s only been one boy I’ve ever wanted since I started thinking about boys and it wasn’t until just recently that I got to join the sex club at all. The struggle is real.
lines.zh: : 我懂。从我开始对男孩子有想法以来，我想得到的男孩子只有一个，而直到最近我才终于加入了「性爱俱乐部」。这挣扎是真的。

lines.en: : We really have endured, haven’t we?
lines.zh: : 我们真的忍过来了，不是吗？

lines.en: scene nikidatewar13
: What? Why are you both looking at me like that?
lines.zh: : 什么？你们两个为什么那样看着我？

lines.en: : I think it’s your turn to talk about the difficulties of not having sex with my big brother. Go on. We won’t judge.
lines.zh: : 我想该轮到你来谈谈「不能和我哥哥上床」有多难了。说吧。我们不会评判你的。

lines.en: : Yeah, that’s not going to happen.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那是不可能的。

lines.en: scene nikidatewar14
: (Menacing dolphin gaze)
lines.zh: : （来者不善的海豚凝视）

lines.en: : Oh. The weird dolphin is suddenly back.
lines.zh: : 噢。那只奇怪的海豚突然又回来了。

lines.en: : That’s no weird dolphin. That’s just my weird sister.
lines.zh: : 那不是什么奇怪的海豚。那只是我那奇怪的姐姐。

lines.en: scene nikidatewar15

: Fucking paparazzi. They finally get a god damn scandal out of me and {i}this{/i} is the way they repay me? Paying so much attention to me that I need to wear shit like {i}this{/i} just to get around them?
lines.zh: : 该死的狗仔。他们终于从我身上挖到了一个天杀的丑闻，然后就用{i}这种{/i}方式报答我？盯着我不放到我得穿成{i}这副鬼样子{/i}才能躲开他们？

lines.en: : That...{i}is{/i} their job.
lines.zh: : 那……{i}就是{/i}他们的工作啊。

lines.en: : Shut up, Otoha. One day, you’re going to be the one wearing a dolphin suit to get around them after {i}you{/i} wind up falling in love with someone you shouldn’t.
lines.zh: : 闭嘴，Otoha。总有一天，等到{i}你{/i}爱上了一个不该爱的人，那个为了躲他们而穿上海豚装的人就会是你。

lines.en: : Haha. Me? Falling in love with someone I shouldn’t? Pfft. Like {i}that{/i} would ever happen.
lines.zh: : 哈哈。我？爱上一个不该爱的人？切。{i}那种事{/i}怎么可能发生。

lines.en: : It’ll probably just be Onii-chan at this rate. He can’t make his final choice in life until he samples all of the available merchandise.
lines.zh: : 照这个势头，大概就会是哥哥吧。他不把所有在售的商品都试用一遍，是做不出人生最终选择的。

lines.en: scene nikidatewar16
: Right! Which is the {i}other{/i} reason I’m here! To deprive him of the opportunity to cheat on me with two {i}more{/i} teenage girls!
lines.zh: : 没错！这也是我来的{i}另一个{/i}原因！就是为了不让他有机会再找{i}两个{/i}十几岁的女孩背着我去偷吃！

lines.en: : See? What’d I say?
lines.zh: : 看吧？我怎么说来着？

lines.en: : Have you already been filled in on the specifics, Niki? Or should I-
lines.zh: : Niki，你已经知道具体情况了吗？还是说我来——

lines.en: : Why are you not more excited to see me? Be more excited to see me.
lines.zh: : 你为什么见到我不更兴奋一点？给我更兴奋一点。

lines.en: : Uhh...{i}kyaaaahhh...{/i}Have you already been filled in on the specifics?
lines.zh: : 呃……{i}呀——啊……{/i}你已经知道具体情况了吗？

lines.en: scene nikidatewar17
: Rooms 308 and 309. Go in, watch them suffer, deliver judgement. Easy-peasy.
lines.zh: : 308 和 309 号房。进去，看她们受苦，然后下判决。简单得很。

lines.en: scene nikidatewar18
: Hi, Niki.
lines.zh: : 嗨，Niki。

lines.en: : Don’t talk to me, fuckface. I’m still mad at you.
lines.zh: : 别跟我说话，贱脸。我还在生你的气。

lines.en: : I understand. I’m sorry.
lines.zh: : 我明白。对不起。

lines.en: : Wow.
: Yeah. Nee-chan’s got him whipped now.
lines.zh: : 是啊。姐姐现在把他收拾得服服帖帖的。

lines.en: : This is all Peter Gabriel’s fault when you really think about it.
lines.zh: : 仔细想想，这一切都是 Peter Gabriel 的错。

lines.en: : No, it’s {i}your{/i} fault for fucking my little sister. And probably this girl too. What’s your name again?
lines.zh: : 不，是你{i}自己{/i}的错，谁让你操了我妹妹。大概还有这个女孩吧。你叫什么来着？

lines.en: scene nikidatewar19
: Me? Makoto Miyamura.
lines.zh: : 我？Makoto Miyamura。

lines.en: : Well, have you been- wait. Are you the same girl who works in the porn shop?
lines.zh: : 嗯，你有没有——等等。你就是在色情店工作的那个女孩吧？

lines.en: : Oh, look. You’re {i}also{/i} famous now, Makoto.
lines.zh: : 噢，瞧。Makoto，你现在{i}也{/i}出名了。

lines.en: : I have been known to sell adult toys and videos, yes. But don’t worry. Store policy says I need to keep all of your purchases confidential.
lines.zh: : 我确实卖成人玩具和录像，没错。不过别担心。店里的规定要求我对你的所有购买记录保密。

lines.en: : Uhh...thanks. That-
lines.zh: : 呃……谢谢。那——

lines.en: : Your many...{i}many{/i} purchases.
lines.zh: : 你那许多……{i}许多{/i}次的购买记录。

lines.en: scene nikidatewar20
: I....I was alone for a really long time, okay?!
lines.zh: : 我……我一个人待了很久很久，好吗？！

lines.en: : Don’t feel bad, Nee-chan. I’m a pervert too.
lines.zh: : 别难过，姐姐。我也是个变态。

lines.en: : And {i}I{/i} am leaving. There’s food upstairs, yeah?
lines.zh: : 而{i}我{/i}要走了。楼上有吃的，对吧？

lines.en: scene nikidatewar21
: Wait, take me with you. I need to change into my regular clothes and I don’t have an elevator key.
lines.zh: : 等等，带上我。我得换回平时的衣服，而我没有电梯钥匙。

lines.en: : Fine, just don’t change in front of me.
lines.zh: : 行，只是别在我面前换。

lines.en: : I won’t. I’ve learned my lesson.
lines.zh: : 不会的。我吸取教训了。

lines.en: : {i}So, what can you tell me about these girls that-{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}那么，关于这两个女孩，你能告诉我——{/i}

lines.en: : She barely acknowledged my existence.
lines.zh: : 她几乎无视了我的存在。

lines.en: : Sure she did. She just...didn’t do it directly for the most part. It’s a step in the right direction though, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 她当然承认了。只是……大部分时候不是直接承认的。不过这算是往对的方向迈了一步吧？

lines.en: : If that direction is emotionally isolating Sensei in order to make him repent, then yes.
lines.zh: : 如果那个方向是在情感上孤立老师、好让他忏悔，那就是吧。

lines.en: : I think that’s the exact direction she’s going for, yeah.
lines.zh: : 我觉得她要的就是这个方向，没错。

lines.en: : I don’t mind her walking all over me if it keeps her close.
lines.zh: : 只要能让她留在我身边，她怎么踩我都无所谓。

lines.en: scene nikidatewar22
: Wow. What an interesting outlook that I definitely don’t relate to at all.
lines.zh: : 哇。多么有意思的想法，而我绝对一点共鸣都没有。

lines.en: : She’ll settle down soon enough, Onii-chan. She got the worst of it out of her system already. From this point on it’s just adapting and coping.
lines.zh: : 她很快就会安定下来的，哥哥。她已经把最狠的那部分发泄完了。从现在开始，就只剩下适应和应对了。

lines.en: : You think so?
lines.zh: : 你这么想？

lines.en: : Mhm. It’s only a matter of time until she’s in the same boat as us.
lines.zh: : 嗯。她迟早会和我们坐上同一条船。

lines.en: scene black
: Tired. Resigned. Desperate. And a million other things that combine to create the burdens we must bear in order to be with you.
lines.zh: : 疲惫。认命。绝望。还有上百万种别的东西，混在一起，构成了我们为了和你在一起而必须背负的重担。

lines.en: : How deep.
lines.zh: : 好深刻。

lines.en: : If you think {i}that’s{/i} deep, you should see his penis inside of me. I’m really skinny, so it kind of pokes out of my belly and-
lines.zh: : 如果你觉得{i}那{/i}就叫深，你该看看他的阴茎在我里面有多深。我很瘦，所以它有点从我肚子上顶出来，然后——

lines.en: : Thank you for the imagery, but I have seen the same thing myself. I was commenting more on your brutally honest outlook for our...romantic potential.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你的画面感，不过我自己也见过同样的景象。我更多是在评价你对于我们……恋爱前景的那种残酷的坦诚。

lines.en: : Oh, speaking of which — how do you think Rin and Uta are going to do?
lines.zh: : 噢，说起这个——你觉得 Rin 和 Uta 会表现如何？

lines.en: scene nikidatewar23
: {i}There’s only one way to find out, really.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}其实只有一个办法能知道。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Tapping into the hidden cameras you guys installed in each of their rooms?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}接进你们装在每个房间里的隐藏摄像头？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Right. I hope you’re good at lip-reading though, because there’s no audio feed.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}没错。不过我希望你擅长读唇语，因为没有音频。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}That’s fine. We don’t need one to watch them have sex.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}没关系。看她们做爱不需要声音。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}It’s going to be your sister in there, you know.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}里面可是你妹妹，你知道吧。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I just want to make sure she’s doing it correctly.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我只是想确认她做得对不对。{/i}

lines.en: : Hah...
: Please don’t be my mom. Please don’t be my mom. Please don’t be my mom.
lines.zh: : 别是我妈。别是我妈。别是我妈。

lines.en: scene nikidatewar24
: Mmmh! Me first?! Really?!
lines.zh: : 嗯嗯！先来我这边？！真的？！

lines.en: scene nikidatewar25
: W...Whatever! You can do this, Rin! You’ve had sex with a girl before! {i}Two{/i} girls, actually! Even if one of those times happened out of literally nowhere and-
lines.zh: : 随、随便啦！你能行的，Rin！你以前和女孩做过爱！其实{i}两个{/i}女孩！虽说其中一次完全是莫名其妙发生的，而且——

lines.en: : Should I do the other girl first? You seem to need a little more time to prepare.
lines.zh: : 我要不要先去另一个女孩那边？你看起来还需要点时间准备。

lines.en: scene nikidatewar26
: No, you can do me now! Three girls is fine! I’m still not very experienced, though! And I don’t know how to top!
lines.zh: : 不，现在就来我这边！三个女孩也没问题！不过我经验还是不多！而且我不知道怎么当攻！

lines.en: scene nikidatewar27
: That...is fine. I was talking more about the whole “dating” thing than literally {i}doing{/i} you. But I guess it’s nice being...confident and prepared?
lines.zh: : 那……没问题。我说的更多是「约会」这件事，而不是字面意义上的「{i}做{/i}」你。不过……自信又做好准备，大概也不错？

lines.en: : N...Niki?! Wait, did you really agree to-
lines.zh: : N、Niki？！等等，你真的答应了——

lines.en: scene nikidatewar28
: Oh, hey! I remember you. Otoha’s girlfriend.
lines.zh: : 噢，嘿！我记得你。Otoha 的女朋友。

lines.en: : Uhh...{i}ex-girlfriend.{/i} We’ve been broken up for a long time now. Do you...really remember me? Because I remember you. Obviously. But I...me...I didn’t think you’d-
lines.zh: : 呃……{i}前女友{/i}。我们已经分手很久了。你……真的记得我吗？因为我记得你。显然。可我……我……我没想到你会——

lines.en: scene nikidatewar29
: Deep breaths, okay? We’ve already met before. And I really am just a regular girl at the end of the day.
lines.zh: : 深呼吸，好吗？我们以前见过。而且说到底，我真的只是个普通的女孩。

lines.en: scene nikidatewar30
: You? Regular? Hahahaha. Yeah. Right. Like I can convince myself of that under pressure in a private hotel room that everybody told me we were going to “get busy” in.
lines.zh: : 你？普通？哈哈哈哈。是啊。对。就好像我能在压力之下说服自己相信这一点似的——在这间所有人都说我们会「忙起来」的私人酒店房间里。

lines.en: scene nikidatewar31
: Is that what you want? To “get busy” with me?
lines.zh: : 那就是你想要的吗？和我「忙起来」？

lines.en: : Uhhhhhhhhhhhh................nooooooo?
lines.zh: : 呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃…………不——要——吧？

lines.en: : Good. Because that’s a terrible way to start off a date and not something I’m interested in. What else have you got?
lines.zh: : 很好。因为那是一个糟糕至极的约会开场，而且我也没那个兴趣。你还有别的什么吗？

lines.en: : J...Just my...body...I...have little else...to...offer you...mnh!
lines.zh: : 就、就只有我的……身体……我……没什么别的东西……可以……给你了……嗯！

lines.en: : Hey. Look at me.
lines.zh: : 嘿。看着我。

lines.en: : That’s a bad idea.
lines.zh: : 那是个坏主意。

lines.en: : How come? You should be experienced after all. You’ve had sex with {i}two{/i} whole girls. Even if one of those times happened out of literally nowhere and-
lines.zh: : 为什么？你可是有经验的人啊。你跟{i}整整两个{/i}女孩做过爱。虽说其中一次完全是莫名其妙发生的，而且——

lines.en: scene nikidatewar32
: Aaaaahhhhh nooooo! You weren’t supposed to hear my mantra! Who the heck chose a hotel room for a first date?! This is terrible!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊不——！你不该听到我的咒语的！到底是谁选了酒店房间当第一次约会的地点？！太糟了！

lines.en: : How have you been? Did my protege let you down gently, at least?
lines.zh: : 你最近怎么样？至少，我的那位徒弟没有太狠地伤你吧？

lines.en: scene nikidatewar33
: It...sucked at first, but...we’re friends now. We just...wanted something different, I guess...
lines.zh: : 一开始……挺糟的，不过……我们现在是朋友了。我们只是……想要不一样的东西吧，大概……

lines.en: : And that was your first break-up, I’m guessing?
lines.zh: : 我猜那是你第一次分手？

lines.en: : It was...yeah. My {i}only{/i} break-up too. Kind of. I don’t really...know. There was a second one too but, like...we weren’t technically {i}together?{/i} And it was also a confession at the same time? I don’t get it.
lines.zh: : 是……是啊。也是我{i}唯一{/i}一次分手。算是吧。我真的……不清楚。还有第二次，不过……我们严格来说不算{i}在一起{/i}吧？而且那同时也是一次告白？我搞不懂。

lines.en: : Love can be a pretty confusing thing, huh? I had my first break-up not too long ago too, you know.
lines.zh: : 爱情是挺让人搞不懂的东西，对吧？我也不久前才第一次分手呢。

lines.en: scene nikidatewar34
: You...did? So...was there someone you were with {i}before{/i} Sensei? Or-
lines.zh: : 你……分手过？那么……在老师{i}之前{/i}还有别人吗？还是——

lines.en: : No. It’s always been him. He just did something I couldn’t forgive him for recently and the two of us went on a bit of a break for it.
lines.zh: : 没有。一直都是他。只是他最近做了件我不能原谅的事，我们两个因此稍微分开了一阵。

lines.en: : But you’re...back together now...right?
lines.zh: : 可你们……现在又在一起了……对吧？

lines.en: : Right. Which I am {i}not{/i} happy about, but...it is what it is, I guess.
lines.zh: : 对。对此我{i}一点也不{/i}高兴，不过……事情就是这样吧，大概。

lines.en: : Well, I’m...sorry if this sounds rude, but...you {i}look{/i} happy. Is that not because of him?
lines.zh: : 嗯，如果这话听起来很没礼貌我先道歉，不过……你{i}看起来{/i}很幸福。那不是因为他吗？

lines.en: : No, it is.
lines.zh: : 不，是因为他。

lines.en: : Then...what? He makes you miserable {i}and{/i} happy and...you can’t forgive him, but you forgave him and took him back?
lines.zh: : 那……什么？他让你痛苦{i}又{/i}让你幸福，而且……你不能原谅他，可你又原谅了他、让他回来了？

lines.en: : None of it makes sense, I know.
lines.zh: : 这一切都说不通，我知道。

lines.en: scene nikidatewar35
: But that just goes to show I’m human, doesn’t it? We all do stuff from time to time that defies logic since that’s what it means to love somebody.
lines.zh: : 可这恰恰说明我是个人，不是吗？我们都会时不时做些不合逻辑的事，因为爱一个人本来就是这样。

lines.en: : I...I see...
lines.zh: : 我……我明白了……

lines.en: : Did you love Otoha?
lines.zh: : 你爱过 Otoha 吗？

lines.en: scene nikidatewar36
: I...{i}thought{/i} I did. I’m not so sure in hindsight, though. Like...my feelings for her were really strong, sure. But I don’t think they were...{i}as{/i} strong as they are for someone else.
lines.zh: : 我……{i}以为{/i}我爱过。不过现在回头看，我不太确定了。就是……我对她的感情确实很强烈，没错。但我不觉得它……{i}有{/i}我对另一个人那么强烈。

lines.en: : Girl number two?
lines.zh: : 第二个女孩？

lines.en: : Girl number two in a way and...and also boy number one.
lines.zh: : 从某种意义上说是第二个女孩，而且……还有第一个男孩。

lines.en: : So there’s a {i}boy{/i} now too? You’re pretty popular, huh?
lines.zh: : 所以现在还有个{i}男孩{/i}？你还挺受欢迎的嘛？

lines.en: : Being popular would mean that boy number one liked me back, but I’m not...sure if he actually does. And girl number two also likes him, so it’s just a whole big mess that I don’t know what to do about.
lines.zh: : 要是第一个男孩也喜欢我，那才叫受欢迎，可我不……确定他到底喜不喜欢。而且第二个女孩也喜欢他，所以整件事就是一团我不知道该怎么处理的大乱麻。

lines.en: : Well, seeing as this is way more fun than roleplaying some kind of date with you, I’ll happily give you as much advice as you want. Assuming you want {i}any{/i} that is.
lines.zh: : 嗯，既然这比和你角色扮演什么约会有意思多了，你要多少建议我都乐意给。前提是你{i}确实{/i}想要的话。

lines.en: : I just can’t guarantee it’ll be good advice since I think, technically speaking, you’ve already had more relationships than I’ve ever had.
lines.zh: : 我只是不敢保证那会是好建议，因为严格来说，你谈过的恋爱可能比我这辈子谈过的都多。

lines.en: scene nikidatewar37
: So Sensei’s really...the only person you’ve ever had feelings for?
lines.zh: : 所以老师真的……是你唯一对之有感觉的人？

lines.en: : I think it’s a disease some childhood friends catch if they develop crushes too early. But yeah. He’s the only one for me, as shitty as it is to admit that.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这是一种病，有些青梅竹马太早动心就会得。不过是啊。他就是我唯一的那个人，尽管承认这点挺糟糕的。

lines.en: : What are the downsides, though? Just that he’s...unfaithful and emotionally closed off? And has a hard time accepting and understanding what it means to love in the first place?
lines.zh: : 那他有什么缺点呢？就只是……不专一、情感封闭？还有很难接受和理解「爱」到底是什么？

lines.en: scene nikidatewar38
: You know him pretty well, huh?
lines.zh: : 你挺了解他的嘛？

lines.en: : I do...
lines.zh: : 是的……

lines.en: : We were really close once upon a time, but...a lot of stuff happened and we sort of grew apart. And we’ve been getting closer again lately, but now there’s this {i}other{/i} girl who-
lines.zh: : 我们曾经非常亲密，可是……发生了很多事，我们渐渐疏远了。最近我们又开始走近，可现在又冒出这个{i}别的{/i}女孩，她——

lines.en: : He’s boy number one, isn’t he?
lines.zh: : 他就是第一个男孩，对吧？

lines.en: : Don’t hit me. Yes.
lines.zh: : 别打我。是的。

lines.en: scene nikidatewar39
: {i}Hah...{/i}Why would I hit you, Rin?
lines.zh: : {i}哈……{/i}我为什么要打你，Rin？

lines.en: : Because we’re alone in a private room and I just kind of told you I have a crush on your boyfriend.
lines.zh: : 因为我们单独待在一间私人房间里，而我刚刚算是告诉你，我喜欢上了你的男朋友。

lines.en: : Who {i}doesn’t?{/i} At least you haven’t actually slept with him. Which, and please don’t take this as a good sign because I don’t want to encourage you, might actually work out in your favor.
lines.zh: : 谁{i}不喜欢{/i}呢？至少你还没真的和他上过床。这一点——请别把它当成什么好兆头，我可不想鼓励你——说不定真会对你有利。

lines.en: scene nikidatewar40
: Huh? What do you-
lines.zh: : 啊？你是什么——

lines.en: : What I mean is that he’s apparently decided to protect you instead of ruin you. Noriko was the same way until recently. That’s what we broke up over.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，他显然决定要保护你，而不是毁掉你。Noriko 直到最近还是那样。我们就是为了这个分的手。

lines.en: : Noriko isn’t {i}ruined,{/i} though. She-
lines.zh: : 可 Noriko 并没有{i}被毁掉{/i}啊。她——

lines.en: : No, I know she isn’t. She’s stronger than me. Stronger than I’ll ever be, probably. And I get what Akira sees in her but, at the same time, there has to be some sort of “line.” You know?
lines.zh: : 不，我知道她没有。她比我坚强。大概比我这一辈子能做到的都坚强。我明白 Akira 看上她什么，可同时，总得有一条「底线」吧。你懂吗？

lines.en: : I do. And I don’t have a sister but, if I did, I imagine I’d feel the same way as you. The part I don’t really get is why not paying attention to me is somehow a good thing.
lines.zh: : 我懂。我没有姐妹，不过要是我有，我想我也会和你有同样的感觉。我不太明白的是，为什么他不理我反而成了好事。

lines.en: scene nikidatewar41
: Well, he’s not avoiding you, is he?
lines.zh: : 嗯，他又不是在躲你，对吧？

lines.en: : No, but-
lines.zh: : 不是，可是——

lines.en: : Then just trust me. As someone who knows him better than anyone, you’re in a good spot right now.
lines.zh: : 那就相信我。作为比任何人都了解他的人，我可以告诉你，你现在的处境很好。

lines.en: scene nikidatewar42
: As his girlfriend, though, that makes you my rival!
lines.zh: : 可作为他的女朋友，那你就是我的情敌！

lines.en: : I...I feel a very...dark energy coming from you right now...
lines.zh: : 我……我现在从你身上感觉到一股非常……黑暗的能量……

lines.en: : Good!
lines.zh: : 很好！

lines.en: scene nikidatewar43
: Because one of the main reasons I wanted to go public about my love for him in the first place is to cut all of you down where you stand.
lines.zh: : 因为我当初想公开我对他的爱，主要原因之一就是把你们所有人就地斩落马下。

lines.en: : You’re still just a kid, Rin. Go after girl number two or literally {i}anyone{/i} your own age. All chasing after that asshole will do is ruin {i}both{/i} of your lives. And you’re too cute to blow yourself up, I think.
lines.zh: : 你还是个孩子，Rin。去追第二个女孩，或者干脆去追{i}任何{/i}和你同龄的人。追那个混蛋只会毁掉{i}你们两个{/i}的人生。而且你太可爱了，我觉得不该把自己炸得粉碎。

lines.en: : But what if I...
lines.zh: : 可要是我……

lines.en: : What if I {i}want{/i} to...blow up?
lines.zh: : 要是我{i}就想{/i}……炸得粉碎呢？

lines.en: scene nikidatewar44
: What if I {i}want{/i} to feel the pain that comes from having my heart broken? What if I {i}want{/i} to hurt instead of just dreaming about all of the things out there that {i}could{/i} hurt me?
lines.zh: : 要是我{i}就想{/i}感受心碎带来的痛呢？要是我{i}就想{/i}受伤，而不只是幻想着外面那些{i}可能{/i}会伤到我的东西呢？

lines.en: : Because most days, I don’t feel anything. But when I’m with him, there’s like...there’s a voice in the back of my head egging me on. Telling me to jump. Telling me that if I {i}don’t,{/i} I’ll be stuck up here forever.
lines.zh: : 因为大多数日子里，我什么都感觉不到。可当我和他在一起时，就好像……我脑子里有个声音在怂恿我。叫我跳下去。告诉我，如果我{i}不跳{/i}，我就会永远困在上面。

lines.en: : And I don’t want that....I want to live. I want to {i}want to{/i} live. And if there’s some sort of obstacle in my way, shouldn’t I be trying to overcome it rather than just waiting for an easier path like I’ve always done?
lines.zh: : 而我不想要那样……我想要活着。我想要{i}想要{/i}活着。如果我面前有某种障碍，我不该试着去克服它吗，而不是像我一直以来那样，等着一条更容易的路出现？

lines.en: : If {i}he’s{/i} the thing that gives me a chance to experience love or joy or whatever it is I’m chasing, then getting hurt isn’t just a side effect. It’s the whole {i}point.{/i} It means I’m here. I feel. I {i}am.{/i}
lines.zh: : 如果{i}他{/i}是那个让我有机会体验爱、喜悦、或者我追逐的随便什么的东西，那么受伤就不只是副作用。那就是全部的{i}意义{/i}。它意味着我在这里。我感受。我{i}存在{/i}。

lines.en: scene nikidatewar45
: Or I {i}could{/i} be...
lines.zh: : 或者我{i}本来可以{/i}是……

lines.en: : But right now, I’m not. Right now, I’m any other girl in any other room, waiting for the right person to walk through the door. But that person isn’t you, so...I...
lines.zh: : 可现在，我不是。现在，我是任何一个房间里任何一个普通的女孩，等着对的人推门进来。可那个人不是你，所以……我……

lines.en: : I think I need to drop out of this competition.
lines.zh: : 我想我需要退出这场比赛。

lines.en: : I think I...don’t want to win.
lines.zh: : 我想我……不想赢。

lines.en: scene nikidatewar46
: Okay, okay. Hold your horses.
lines.zh: : 好好好。别急。

lines.en: : I don’t have any horses. I think you have me confused with Touka.
lines.zh: : 我没有马。我想你把我当成 Touka 了。

lines.en: : No, I just meant that Akira {i}is{/i} still the “prize” or whatever if your floor comes out on top, right? Your other teacher told me all about it.
lines.zh: : 不，我只是想说，如果你们楼层最终胜出，Akira {i}就是{/i}那个「奖品」什么的，对吧？你们的另一位老师全跟我说了。

lines.en: : Well...yes. But-
lines.zh: : 嗯……是的。可是——

lines.en: scene nikidatewar47

: I’m not going to sit here any longer and give you advice on how to proceed with your own life. I barely know you. You barely know me. And even if we’re rivals, I’m not going to tell you to stop following your heart.
lines.zh: : 我不会再坐在这儿，对你自己的人生该怎么走指手画脚了。我几乎不了解你。你也几乎不了解我。而且就算我们是情敌，我也不会叫你别跟着自己的心走。

lines.en: : Besides, your head’s screwed on a lot tighter than mine ever was at your age. It’s kind of cool, actually.
lines.zh: : 再说，你在我这个年纪时，头脑可比我清醒多了。说实话，还挺酷的。

lines.en: : You...think I’m cool?
lines.zh: : 你……觉得我酷？

lines.en: : Yeah. I can see what Otoha saw in you. And what Akira probably does too since age is just a meaningless fucking number to him.
lines.zh: : 是啊。我看得出 Otoha 在你身上看到了什么。Akira 大概也一样，毕竟对他来说，年龄不过是个没意义的狗屁数字。

lines.en: : I’m sorry for...falling for him. I tried to stop it. I really did.
lines.zh: : 对不起……我爱上了他。我试过阻止自己。我真的试过。

lines.en: : It’s fine. I don’t blame you at all.
lines.zh: : 没关系。我一点都不怪你。

lines.en: : I just hope the next girl is a little more infatuated with {i}me.{/i} I could use the confidence boost right now.
lines.zh: : 我只希望下一个女孩能更迷恋{i}我{/i}一点。我现在正需要一点自信。

lines.en: scene nikidatewar48
: Uta-chan — engage! There’s no need for regular ole’ Uta in here!
lines.zh: : Uta——上吧！这里不需要平时的那个 Uta！

lines.en: : The time has come to wear your big girl pants and turn the charm on so you can win additional quality time  with the boy you like! Even {i}if{/i} that boy is not the one you get to date today!
lines.zh: : 是时候穿上大人的裤子、打开魅力开关了，好为你赢得更多和你喜欢的男孩相处的宝贵时间！{i}就算{/i}那个男孩不是你今天要约会的对象！

lines.en: scene nikidatewar49
: Just think of it like another shift at the cafe. You talk to pretty girls all the time. What could possibly go wrong?
lines.zh: : 就当成是在咖啡馆的又一个班次。你天天都跟漂亮女孩说话。能出什么岔子？

lines.en: : {i}Ahem.{/i}
scene nikidatewar50
: Heh?
scene nikidatewar51
: Hi.
scene nikidatewar52
: I needed that.
lines.zh: : 我正需要这个。

lines.en: scene black
scene nikidatewar53
: Mnh...
lines.zh: : 嗯嗯……

lines.en: : What the?...
lines.zh: : 什么鬼？……

lines.en: scene nikidatewar54
: When did I...hit my head?...
lines.zh: : 我什么时候……撞到头了？……

lines.en: scene nikidatewar55
: Is the...competition-
lines.zh: : 比赛……是不是——

lines.en: scene nikidatewar56
scene black
scene nikidatewar57
: This is not what it looks like.
lines.zh: : 这不是你看到的那样。

lines.en: : Are you sure?
lines.zh: : 你确定吗？

lines.en: : Because it can be what it looks like.
lines.zh: : 因为它也可以是那样。

lines.en: : That-
: Misunderstandings can lead to good things too.
lines.zh: : 误会也能带来好事情。

lines.en: scene nikidatewar58
: You fainted! I was just helping you get into bed!
lines.zh: : 你昏倒了！我只是扶你上床而已！

lines.en: : Oh.
: Yeah!
lines.zh: : 对啊！

lines.en: : Well...I think I need more help with other stuff now.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我想我现在别的事也需要帮忙。

lines.en: : Other stuff?! Like what?!
lines.zh: : 别的事？！比如什么？！

lines.en: : I don’t know if I should say it out loud.
lines.zh: : 我不知道该不该说出口。

lines.en: scene nikidatewar59
: Yeah, so, Rin wins.
lines.zh: : 好吧，总之，Rin 赢了。

lines.en: : Jesus, Uta. Just how badly did you drop the ball? I literally tried to quit.
lines.zh: : 天哪，Uta。你到底把球掉得多惨？我可是真的试着退出了。

lines.en: : I don’t want to talk about it. Ever. For the rest of my life.
lines.zh: : 我不想谈这件事。永远。这辈子都不想。

lines.en: : They call that the Niki effect. I used to have to hand out water bottles and cold compresses to all of the girls who’d faint at Nee-chan’s handshake events.
lines.zh: : 这叫「Niki 效应」。以前在姐姐的握手会上，我得给所有晕倒的女孩发水和冰袋。

lines.en: : The hell happened in Uta’s room? Girl looks like she just hopped out of the sauna.
lines.zh: : Uta 的房间里到底发生了什么？那女孩看起来像刚从桑拿房里跳出来。

lines.en: : What a coincidence. That is also how I feel.
lines.zh: : 真巧。我也是这感觉。

lines.en: scene nikidatewar60
: Noriko.
lines.zh: : Noriko。

lines.en: : One bottle of water and a cold compress coming right up!
lines.zh: : 一瓶水和一个冰袋，马上送到！

lines.en: scene nikidatewar61
: Okay! So if Niki is confident that Rin is the winner tonight, it brings our day one tally to 3-2 in favor of the first floor!
lines.zh: : 好的！那么，如果 Niki 认定 Rin 是今晚的赢家，我们第一天的比分就是 3 比 2，一楼领先！

lines.en: : Who are you talking to?
lines.zh: : 你在跟谁说话？

lines.en: : Any words for our members, Rin?
lines.zh: : Rin，有什么想对会员们说的吗？

lines.en: scene nikidatewar62
: Just...that I’m very thankful there was no audio feed in the hotel room.
lines.zh: : 只是……我很庆幸酒店房间里没有音频。

lines.en: : Same. {i}Big{/i} same.
lines.zh: : 同感。{i}非常{/i}同感。

lines.en: : Seriously, though. There’s no one there.
lines.zh: : 不过说真的。那边根本没人。
